seo_title: Cost of Living in Athens 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Athens per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A Schengen city with a Golden Visa from 250,000 euros: a path to EU citizenship, mild winters and well-developed Russian-speaking infrastructure. The city blends ancient heritage with a modern IT scene.
pros: Golden Visa for buying property from 250,000 euros
A direct path to EU citizenship after 7 years of residency
Sea and islands an hour from the centre
Developed Russian-speaking infrastructure: schools, doctors, notaries
cons: Rents rose sharply after the influx of foreigners
Greek is essential for long-term daily life

best_places.name: Plaka
best_places.description: The old town at the foot of the Acropolis: taverns, boutiques, neoclassical mansions.

best_places.name: Kolonaki
best_places.description: A premium district with galleries, fusion restaurants and designer boutiques.

best_places.name: Coho
best_places.description: The main coworking of the English-speaking community, with meeting rooms and an event venue.

best_places.name: Glyfada
best_places.description: A coastal southern suburb: beaches, sports clubs, a favourite of families with children.

visa_steps.title: Schengen visa
visa_steps.description: A C or D visa through the Greek embassy. It takes 2–4 months, requirements are strict.

visa_steps.title: Golden Visa
visa_steps.description: Buying property from 250,000 euros (outside Athens) or 800,000 euros (in the centre) grants a 5-year residence permit.

visa_steps.title: Digital Nomad Visa
visa_steps.description: For remote workers with income from 3,500 euros a month — a one-year residence permit, renewable.

visa_steps.title: AFM and AMKA
visa_steps.description: A tax number and a social security number. Without them you can't open an account or sign a lease.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: Eurobank, Piraeus and Alpha Bank open accounts with a residence permit and an AFM. Cards work without restrictions.

faq.question: How is it with the language in Athens?
faq.answer: English is enough for tourism and IT, but for healthcare and school you need Greek.

faq.question: Is Athens good for children?
faq.answer: Strong international schools (ACS, Byron, Campion). Prices from 8,000 euros a year.

faq.question: How much does a Golden Visa cost in Athens?
faq.answer: From 250,000 euros in property + 2,000–5,000 euros for lawyers and notaries.

faq.question: Can I work for Western companies in Athens?
faq.answer: Yes, through a digital nomad visa or by registering as a sole trader. Tax is 22% after the preferential regime.

faq.question: Is the climate harsh in Athens?
faq.answer: Summers reach +35–40°C, you need to live with air conditioning. Winters are mild but rainy.

faq.question: Is Athens safe?
faq.answer: The city is safe, but there's a lot of petty pickpocketing in the centre. Residential districts — no problems.

reviews.text: I bought an apartment in Glyfada for 320,000 euros and got a Golden Visa for the whole family. My daughter is in an international school, summers are on the islands. I love Greece, but you have to get used to the bureaucracy.
I got a Digital Nomad Visa and rent a studio in Kolonaki. I work for a startup in Berlin and pay a preferential tax. Athens is both work and a way of life.
